name: getElectorate
description: Searches Electorates in EIM/Electorate.aspx by electorate code, electorate name, or district name. Name/district searches use partial, case-insensitive matching and return all matching rows from the grid. Also supports returning all existing electorates via the screen’s Show All action when the user requests “all / available / existing / list”. If exactly one match is found, the tool opens the record and returns detailed fields.

basic.name: getElectorate
basic.description: Searches Electorates in EIM/Electorate.aspx by electorate code, electorate name, or district name. Name/district searches use partial, case-insensitive matching and return all matching rows from the grid. Also supports returning all existing electorates via the screen’s Show All action when the user requests “all / available / existing / list”. If exactly one match is found, the tool opens the record and returns detailed fields.

args.name: electorateCode
args.description: The electorate code to search for (e.g.: "000002")

args.name: electorateName
args.description: The electorate name to search for (e.g.: "hSenid")

args.name: districtName
args.description: District name to search for. Uses criteria D.DISTRICT_NAME. Partial match, case-insensitive.

args.name: returnAll
args.description:
"yes" to return all electorates (uses Show All).
Also auto-triggers when electorateCode / electorateName / districtName is: "all", "available", "existing", "list", "show all".

args.name: fetchDetails
args.description:
"yes" / "no" (default "yes").
If exactly 1 result and "yes", opens record and returns detailed values.

args.name: pageSize
args.description:
Page size used during initial grid load/search (example: "10", "50").
The tool will still adapt to UI page size after the first response.

args.name: matchMode
args.description:
Name matching behavior when searching by electorateName or districtName:
"contains" (default) → partial match
"exact" → exact match only
